description: This file implements a dynamic vector data structure in C, providing functions for creating, destroying, pushing, removing, accessing, and searching elements within the vector. It also includes utility functions for cleaning up items and comparing strings.

classes.name: struct _rtVector
classes.description: The internal data structure representing the vector, containing a dynamic array of void pointers, with capacity and count tracking current size.

methods.name: rtError rtVector_Create(rtVector * v)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new rtVector instance.

methods.name: rtError rtVector_Destroy(rtVector v,rtVector_Cleanup destroyer)
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the vector and its items using an optional destroyer function.

methods.name: rtError rtVector_PushBack(rtVector v,void * item)
methods.description: Appends a new item to the end of the vector, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: rtError rtVector_RemoveItem(rtVector v,void * item,rtVector_Cleanup destroyer)
methods.description: Removes the specified item from the vector, optionally cleaning it up.

methods.name: rtError rtVector_RemoveItemByCompare(rtVector v,const void * comparison,rtVector_Compare compare,rtVector_Cleanup destroyer)
methods.description: Removes an item matching a criterion defined by a comparison function.

methods.name: void * rtVector_At(rtVector v,size_t index)
methods.description: Returns the item at a specific index, or NULL if out of bounds.

methods.name: size_t rtVector_Size(rtVector v)
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the vector.

methods.name: int rtVector_HasItem(rtVector v,const void * comparison,rtVector_Compare compare)
methods.description: Checks if the vector contains an item matching a given comparison.

methods.name: void * rtVector_Find(rtVector v,const void * comparison,rtVector_Compare compare)
methods.description: Finds and returns an item matching a comparison criterion.

methods.name: void rtVector_Cleanup_Free(void * item)
methods.description: Frees an item, typically used as a cleanup callback.

methods.name: int rtVector_Compare_String(const void * left,const void * right)
methods.description: String comparison function for vector elements.

ctags.name: rtVector_Find
ctags.pattern: /^rtVector_Find(rtVector v, const void* comparison, rtVector_Compare compare)$/

ctags.name: rtVector_HasItem
ctags.pattern: /^rtVector_HasItem(rtVector v, const void* comparison, rtVector_Compare compare)$/

ctags.name: rtVector_RemoveItemByCompare
ctags.pattern: /^rtVector_RemoveItemByCompare(rtVector v, const void* comparison, rtVector_Compare compare, rtVec/
